requirements.requirement: The system must define a fixed enumeration of clinical trial enrollment statuses including RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, and UNKNOWN.
The system must assign a deterministic numeric score weight to each defined enrollment status.
The system must ensure RECRUITING has the highest score weight among all statuses.
The system must assign lower score weights to non-recruiting statuses than to RECRUITING.
The system must define UNKNOWN as a valid fallback status with an explicitly assigned score weight.
The system must normalize all incoming status values to one of the defined enumeration values.
The system must map any unrecognized or null status input to UNKNOWN.
The system must define an output schema that includes at minimum status_category and status_score fields.
The system must ensure the status_score field is a normalized numeric value within a bounded range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100).
The system must produce a consistent output contract structure for every evaluated clinical trial regardless of status.
The system must ensure the schema is serializable into JSON for downstream consumption.
The system must not allow undefined status categories to appear in the output schema.
The system must handle missing status input without throwing runtime errors.
The system must return UNKNOWN with its corresponding score when status input is missing or null.
The system must ensure that the status-to-score mapping is deterministic and produces the same output for the same input across executions.
